upcoming: Crafting, hiring and research move into the ship interior instead of opening base-game screens.
Co-op folded into Standard rather than a separate game mode.
notes: The tactical minimap keeps its proper padded frame at every screen size.
fixes: The minimap no longer draws two frames at once. The gold corner brackets belong to the older HUD layout, and the rule removing them for the tactical dock - along with its padding - was gated behind a phone-width media query, so at any other viewport you got the dock plus brackets bolted to a box that did not want them, with the map bleeding to the edge.
features: Whether the minimap shows corner brackets now depends on which HUD layout is running, not on how wide the screen is, so the docked frame stays locked and padded at every viewport.
